title: Image + caption — the most common variant
description: Verifies the PlotImage widget's most common configuration: a centred image inside a `<figure>` with a `<figcaption>`. No source-code disclosure.

data.markdown:
## When to use PlotImage

Use the PlotImage widget when you have a **pre-rendered figure** (PNG/JPG/SVG/WebP) that you want to embed inside a lesson. The widget gives you:

- A centred `<figure>` with the image and an optional caption.
- An optional **Show source** disclosure that reveals the syntax-highlighted source code that generated the figure.
- Mandatory `alt` text (accessibility).

If you want the figure to react to user input, use **ParametricExplorer** instead — that widget re-renders the figure on every parameter change.
